model.description: Hawkeye warehouse-safety VLM, Qwen3.5-2B LoRA merge, Q4_K_M language weights + F16 vision encoder (University of Guelph, J. S. Sohal). Pulled with the model card quick start `ollama pull hf.co/Jsohal174/hawkeye-warehouse-safety-gguf` (Ollama 0.32.5); the two blobs equal the HF LFS objects below.

samples.description: Two held-out test images of the official synthetic dataset (generated renders, not CCTV). Chosen as the first file of each category whose upstream published per-image result (outputs/hawkeye_test_results_fixed.json @ 67b00ab) was correct; not an accuracy sample.

ollama.description: Official Ollama image; same version as the host binary used for the 2026-10-23 feasibility run on the RTX 5060 Ti

upstream_code.license: none declared; only the prompt text and category names are reused

adapter.description: Python standard-library adapter base image (no third-party packages)
